review.samplingNote: Samples overlap; counts are not unique-frame totals. All 15 dense sheets, five boundary sheets, the native chapter sheet and selected full-size originals were visually inspected.
review.nativePlayback: Prepared native-speed clip with original audio. Review was visual frame/transcript based; continuous audiovisual playback and sound-effect onset analysis were not verified.
review.qualityLimit: Original 640×360. Exact font, physical camera values, hidden geometry and provenance of reference cutouts are unresolved. Diagnostic frames are not automatically production assets.

narrativeContext: The supplied transcript connects these images as: the personalized running shoes/gift → athlete gifting context → Owens’s four-medal success → political reaction → promotion and worldwide orders → underlying tension between the brothers → a chapter break. These are supplied narration/graphic claims and context, not independently verified historical findings. Visually, the product floats into the meeting shot and later appears held toward camera; a literal hand-to-hand exchange is not shown. The following chapter’s stable title hold and factory argument narrative continue beyond 07:55 and are outside this interval.
coverage: The current Library source was resolved as Motionclone-v73-source.zip, version 3, and its actual renderer/defaults/timeline were inspected. olympicStages ends at original source 415s (06:55); its factory template endpoint is 425s (07:05). The entire continuation after original 06:55 is absent. The meeting setup, sky, character slots and several effect engines exist, but the shoe insert, seated-athlete scene, held-shoe pose, medal/podium assembly, worldwide-order map, factory-tension sequence and Chapter 3 entrance have not been implemented. No source ZIP, app code, production asset or user setting was changed for this analysis.
assetPlan:
Reusable: Olympic entrance and yellow living sky; existing Addi/Owens meeting slots for continuity; near audience; brother/profile images where suitable; workshop/factory imagery; geometry, camera, glow, irregular-mask and text systems; the V68 path engine’s dots/dashes/solid/arrows and independent motion. The existing frontal political photograph/glows can be reused as the V73 archive-card treatment, with its documented mismatch to the isolated original retained.

New or refined groups: (1) accurate black low-cut running-spike product with consistent floating/held/map-origin views; (2) gray athletics-ground/treeline and seated-athlete figures; (3) smiling Owens holding the shoe, with grip/contact and foreground hand masks; (4) specific podium/winner/side-athlete photographic layers with verified provenance; (5) appropriate facing/concerned brother profiles for gold/factory scenes if existing angles/smiles fail; (6) a geographically verified map plus parchment/chart treatment; (7) unbranded banknote-like planes. Title text, podium/plinth, routes, masks, flashes, red light and chapter particles should remain editable code/text/vector/effect layers. This is a group inventory, not a committed final asset count. Keep generated supports illustrative and verify source-image permission before production.
recommendation:
After approval, work in four bounded groups: shoe/gifting and athlete poses; medal/political-success composition; map and return-to-factory transitions; red confrontation plus the beginning of Chapter 3. Prepare shared assets for each group, verify framing/alpha/grip, then implement its entrance/hold/exit and compare in motion before moving on. Keep the same black shoe across the floating insert, held product and route-map origin.

For stronger story-driven drama, preserve the bright yellow success palette before the confrontation’s localized red spill, then give the near-black pause room before the new chapter title. Concentrate motion on the foreground shoe/focus change, anchored outward route drawing, opposing brother framing and the final glyph entrance. Preserve the distinction between the first background-only flash and the later whole-scene flash. Avoid extra arbitrary flashes or shrinking everything into a single flattened image.
